pages.title: S02:E01 - The Hunting Party
pages.description: Bob Lee and wife Julie join his former Marine unit in Germany and narrowly escape a deadly terrorist attack. FBI Agent Nadine Memphis takes a job in Washington with Patricia.
Framed for a presidential assassination attempt, an ex-Marine sniper goes on the run, setting out to find those responsible for double-crossing him.
pages.title: Shooter

episodes.description: Highly-decorated war hero Bob Lee Swagger is recruited by his former Commander to prevent an assassination of the President.
episodes.title: S01:E01 - Point of Impact

episodes.description: Bob Lee struggles to protect his family from behind bars while Isaac attempts to silence him.
episodes.title: S01:E02 - Exfil

episodes.description: Bob Lee reaches out to Nadine as he evades his pursuers, putting her on to the cop who took credit for his capture. Isaac juggles his double life as he tries to find Bob Lee.
episodes.title: S01:E03 - Musa Qala

episodes.description: In a flashback to their time serving in Afghanistan, Bob Lee and Isaac clash with opposing ideologies.
episodes.title: S01:E04 - Overwatch

episodes.description: Bob Lee finds the bullet from the assassination, leading him to a radical militia group and a reckoning with Isaac while Nadine is locked in a deadly game of cat & mouse.
episodes.title: S01:E05 - Recon by Fire

episodes.description: Bob Lee tracks down his former instructor Rathford O’Brien to help him find the shooter. Nadine interrogates Payne and a reporter approaches Julie with a deal.
episodes.title: S01:E06 - Killing Zone

episodes.description: Bob Lee crosses the country to find the shooter while Julie deals with a family betrayal.
episodes.title: S01:E07 - Danger Close

episodes.description: Bob Lee and Nadine weave a plan to secure the evidence that could expose the conspiracy.
episodes.title: S01:E08 - Red on Red

episodes.description: Bob Lee must broker a dangerous exchange in order to save his family. Nadine struggles to balance her allegiances to Bob Lee and the FBI.
episodes.title: S01:E09 - Ballistic Advantage

episodes.description: Bob Lee, Julie, Nadine, and Isaac must work together to breach the Russian Embassy, save Mary, shut down the conspiracy and its remaining players, and prove Bob Lee innocent.
episodes.title: S01:E10 - Primer Contact
